groups.saying_opens: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يستأذننا
كنت أقول إن كان ذلك إلى

notes: two sayings: Mu'adha's question («قالت معاذة فقلت لها») starts a second saying whose answer («قالت كنت أقول») is Aisha's; both are stored, the second keeps the shared head up to Mu'adha
«- المعنى -» is an editor gloss and is left out
Aisha is named in the first chain only; in the second her answer is taken as hers through «لها» (the same person)
